title: Dependabot version updates introduce default package cooldown
summary: GitHub announced that Dependabot will introduce a default package cooldown period to limit the frequency of automatic version update notifications and pull requests, helping teams avoid notification fatigue from dependency update spam.
problem_solved: Prevents dependency management tools from sending too frequent update notifications and creating excessive pull requests that overwhelm development teams.
why_valuable: Reduces developer distraction and CI/CD resource consumption by batching dependency updates into manageable intervals instead of generating a flood of individual update PRs.
